title: Pivotal
description: Settings for the Pivotal JupyterLab extension

viewerArea.title: Viewer panel area
viewerArea.description: Where to place the Object Viewer panel. 'right' puts it in the right sidebar (default); 'main' opens it as a tab in the main area — you can drag it to split below or beside the notebook; 'down' places it in the bottom panel.

viewerWidth.title: Right sidebar initial width (px)
viewerWidth.description: Initial width in pixels of the right sidebar when viewerArea is 'right'. JupyterLab reads --jp-sidebar-default-width on first load; after you manually resize the panel, your preference is saved and this setting has no further effect.
